items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You and St. Cyr and Ori and Johnny Dodds was on the date. Yes, yes. Those, that's right.

ctx.x: No. He was on those Jelly Roll records, Stomp Evans. Oh, I know who you're talking about. It wasn't him. No, no, it wasn't him. Oh, I can't think of those fellas. Well, that's alright, yes. And there was another one, then Lewis would come down after the theater, see, after the theater,

he played at the, uh, at the, uh, Vendome Theater. And after the theater was over, he'd come down and play. Mm-hmm. Was it Ori? No. See, Roy Palmer was around, and Venson, and Dutre. Dutre, he was with Joe. And Dutre, he was with Joe. Yeah. And then he was playing at the theater, see, after, he played at the, uh, Vendome Theater. And after the theater was over, he'd come down and play. Mm-hmm. And, okay, we had two, two topics and trombone. I think, uh, seems to me like Ori was playing trombone. Was it Ori? No.…

items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Kidori, I guess he didn't bother with music much in those days, did he? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, he, no, he, he could sit down and play too, that way.

ctx.x: Well, he, yes, he'd, he'd, he'd write them out. Write them out because, now there's some, now I was always, a guy couldn't, I'd have to have something, a guide, you know, go along. Yes. And then if I could, uh, get something, you know, work something into it, whatever. Put in a little extra thing. Yes, but I, I, some of those fellas could just, just play, you know, sit on, go on a job and wouldn't need anything. Just sit on and start to play and anything a guy playing could, but I, I don't know.
Kidori, I guess he didn't bother with music much in those days, did he? Well, well. He can read, I know he can read.

No, he, no, he, he could sit down and play too, that way. That, that's, a lot of those boys could just, just, just play and go through a thing. But I, I don't know, I'm a little thick-headed, I guess. Oh, no, there's a lot of people with that. I couldn't, uh, you know, I'd have to have some kind of, a guy in jail would always fix up something for me to, you know.
